items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Okay. I’d like to read a paragraph here and perhaps you have a comment or reaction to it. This is from Steve Fudderman who wrote for “Night Life.” [INTERVIEWEE] In the New Yorker.

ctx.x: And ever since I moved out to Jersey from the City it’s been — I used to practice karate all the time and it’s been harder since I’ve been out here but I’ve done better. I’m just getting back to it now because my folks died unfortunately, so getting back to my life. And that’s a big part of it.
